issues.t: Clutch pressure plate spring can break (recall)
issues.sym: Trouble shifting gears, a clutch pedal that feels wrong, or a sudden loss of drive.
issues.why: On manual-transmission cars, the diaphragm spring in the clutch pressure plate can crack. A failed pressure plate is the top owner complaint for the 2012 model, at around 35,000 miles. Recall 16V-302 adds a clutch pedal limiter and switch.
issues.next: Run your VIN for the recall and have it done. If the clutch already feels off or the car will not go into gear, have it towed instead of forcing it.

issues.sym: A check engine light, misfire codes on one or more cylinders, a rough or dying idle, often worst on cold start.
issues.why: The MultiAir unit (often called the brick) uses oil pressure and solenoids to open the intake valves. Its solenoids can stick or fail, especially if the oil is old or the level is low.
issues.next: Have the codes read; MultiAir solenoid codes point straight at the unit. Keep the oil fresh and at the right level, since this system depends on clean oil. A failed unit is replaced as an assembly.

issues.t: Misfires from ignition coils and spark plugs
issues.sym: A shaky idle, stumbling acceleration, or a flashing check engine light. Some owners say it comes back even after new plugs and a coil.
issues.why: Coils and plugs on these engines fail and cause misfires. Rusted spark plug tubes and leaking plug seals have also been found behind repeat misfires.
issues.next: Have the misfiring cylinder identified. If a new coil and plug do not fix it, ask the shop to check the plug tube seal and the MultiAir unit.

issues.t: Engine oil leaks from seals and gaskets
issues.sym: Oil spots under the car, a burning oil smell at idle, or a falling oil level.
issues.why: Owners of 2012 cars report leaks from the rear main seal, oil pan, valve cover and the exhaust manifold studs, which some dealers replaced with updated bolts.
issues.next: Find the source before the oil level drops; low oil also hurts the MultiAir system. Small leaks can wait for a planned visit.

issues.sym: A whine or grinding from the engine, loss of power, smoke, or the engine going into limp mode.
issues.why: Owners of 2015 turbo models report the turbo's compressor coming apart at low mileage, around 10,000 miles.
issues.next: Stop driving hard and have it checked at once; pieces of a failed turbo can damage the engine. Ask about warranty coverage on a young car.

issues.sym: Clunking over bumps, loose or wandering steering, or uneven tire wear.
issues.why: Owners of the 2012 model report front ball joints wearing out early, around 45,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the front suspension inspected. Worn ball joints are a safety issue because a separated joint can collapse the wheel.

issues.sym: An outside door handle snaps or will not open the door, a mirror falls off, or a window drops into the door.
issues.why: Broken door handles are the most-reported problem on the 2012 500, and 2017 owners still report fractured handles and windows falling into the door because of failed regulators.
issues.next: Use the other door for now and have the handle or window regulator replaced. Aftermarket handles are an option.

issues.t: Engine will not crank and key stuck in ignition
issues.sym: The engine will not turn over, the key will not come out, and the shifter may not move as it should.
issues.why: RepairPal lists this as a reported 500 problem. It usually points to the ignition switch, the key-release interlock or the shifter's park switch.
issues.next: Try moving the shifter firmly into Park and turning the key again. If it keeps happening, have the ignition and shifter interlock checked.

issues.sym: The shifter does not match the gear the car is in, or the car rolls when left in Park.
issues.why: A bushing on the shifter cable of the 6-speed automatic can wear out so the cable comes loose. Recall 19V-817.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake until the free repair is done. Dealers replace the cable adjuster.

issues.sym: A soft or sinking brake pedal or longer stops.
issues.why: Contaminated brake fluid could damage rubber seals in the brake system and reduce braking. Recall 11V-550.
issues.next: Run your VIN for open recalls; dealers replace affected brake parts free of charge.

issues.t: Tire pressure warning may not light (recall)
issues.sym: The tire pressure light does not come on even when a tire is low.
issues.why: The tire pressure monitoring module may not warn the driver. Recall 24V-474.
issues.next: Have the dealer reprogram the module free of charge, and check tire pressures monthly with a gauge.

issues.t: Spare tire pressure label is wrong (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom; the door placard lists a spare tire pressure higher than the spare's maximum.
issues.why: Filling the spare to the placard value could overinflate it. Recall 16V-667.
issues.next: Inflate the spare to the pressure on its sidewall and have the dealer add the corrected label.

issues.sym: A propulsion warning, a not-ready message, and the car shifting itself into neutral and losing drive.
issues.why: The electric vehicle control unit (EVCU) can set a fault that puts the car in neutral. Recall 15V-291 reprograms it.
issues.next: Make sure the recall software is installed. If it still happens, pull over safely and have the dealer check for updated software.

issues.t: 500e losing power or shutting off while driving
issues.sym: The car suddenly loses power or dies while driving, sometimes with a propulsion warning.
issues.why: Owners report the 500e stalling or shutting down, at times at highway speed. Fixes have included a new EVCU or power inverter software.
issues.next: Get off the road safely, then have the dealer read the codes and check for software updates and open recalls.

issues.sym: The plastic charging port cracks or breaks when plugging in, or charging will not start.
issues.why: The 500e charge port is fragile and can break with regular plugging and unplugging. Damage can reach the wiring harness behind it.
issues.next: Plug and unplug gently and stop using a cracked port. Get it checked early, before the wiring harness is damaged.

issues.sym: Charging stops early, a red plugged-in light, a hot or melted plug, or a burning smell.
issues.why: Owners report the portable charging cord frying and a wall outlet melting while charging, plus charging interruptions.
issues.next: Stop using any cord or outlet that is hot, scorched or melted. Have an electrician check the outlet, or charge on a proper Level 2 charger.

issues.sym: The car will not start or power up, and the key may not come out.
issues.why: The small 12-volt battery that runs the car's electronics can run flat, even after an overnight charge of the main battery.
issues.next: Have the 12-volt battery tested and replaced if weak. A dealer may suggest a trickle charger if it keeps happening.

issues.sym: No warning sign.
issues.why: A seat belt buckle sensor may be connected wrong, so the front passenger airbag may not deploy correctly. Recall 24V-510.
issues.next: Have the dealer repair the connection free of charge.

issues.sym: Headlights that seem aimed too far to one side or dazzle other drivers.
issues.why: The horizontal headlight aim adjuster is not covered as required, so the aim can be changed. Recall 25V-715.
issues.next: Have the dealer fit the headlight adjustment plugs free of charge.

issues.t: Sudden shutdown while driving or charging
issues.sym: The car loses power or shuts off while driving or charging; one owner reported the steering stiffening at 70 mph.
issues.why: Owners of the 2024 500e have reported unexpected shutdowns to NHTSA. The cause has not been published.
issues.next: Pull over safely, then have a dealer read the codes and check for software updates.

issues.sym: The backup camera image freezes while reversing.
issues.why: An owner of a 2024 500e reported to NHTSA that the camera picture freezes several times a week.
issues.next: Use mirrors and look behind you when backing up, and ask the dealer about software updates.

issues.sym: Windows, A/C and heat, the touchscreen or push-button start stop working now and then.
issues.why: A 2024 500e owner reported several electrical systems failing on and off to NHTSA.
issues.next: Note when it happens and have the dealer check for updates while the car is under warranty.
